name: Welcome to Wimblewick
source:
One day, Ryo is informed that he’ll have to move to Wimblewick Isle. And while the place isn’t too far from his city, you could say some of the people there have a little...  [b]extra[/b] charm to them.

What is Wimblewick about? Well this is a NSFW visual novel and therefore it should only be play by legal adults, and on that note I will also mention that all charcters depicted in this work are also legal adults. The main focus of the game is [b]futa on male[/b]… so if you dare step into this land, enter at your own peril...

[From [url=https://edoumdoum.itch.io/welcometowimblewick]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
某天，凉得知自己必须搬去温布尔威克岛生活。虽说那座岛离他所在的城市并不算远，但岛上的某些居民身上，着实有着那么一点……[b]格外突出[/b]的魅力。

《欢迎来到温布尔威克》究竟讲了什么？这是一部成人向（NSFW）视觉小说，仅限法定成年人游玩；顺带一提，本作中登场的所有角色也均为法定成年人。游戏的核心题材聚焦于[b]扶他攻男受[/b]……所以倘若你敢踏足这片土地，一切后果自负……

[摘自[url=https://edoumdoum.itch.io/welcometowimblewick]itch.io[/url]]
